items.quote: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven
items.claim: God swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Israel to multiply their descendants

items.quote: all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed
items.claim: God promised to give the land to the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel

items.quote: they shall inherit it for ever
items.claim: The descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel shall inherit the land perpetually
